steps.name: prepare-task81-local-nprobe-tg256-surface
args: CREATE EXTENSION IF NOT EXISTS ecaz; SET client_min_messages TO notice; DROP INDEX IF EXISTS task81_nprobe_100k_idx; DROP TABLE IF EXISTS task81_nprobe_100k_corpus; DROP TABLE IF EXISTS task81_nprobe_100k_queries; CREATE TABLE task81_nprobe_100k_corpus AS TABLE task79_surface_100k_corpus; CREATE TABLE task81_nprobe_100k_queries AS TABLE task79_surface_100k_queries; ANALYZE task81_nprobe_100k_corpus; ANALYZE task81_nprobe_100k_queries; SET ec_spire.leaf_block_rows = 16; CREATE INDEX task81_nprobe_100k_idx ON task81_nprobe_100k_corpus USING ec_spire (embedding ecvector_spire_ip_ops) WITH (nlists = 128, recursive_fanout = 8, nprobe = 24, rerank_width = 25, storage_format = 'rabitq', boundary_replica_count = 0, top_graph_enabled = 1, top_graph_degree = 32, top_graph_build_list_size = 100, top_graph_search_list_size = 256); RESET ec_spire.leaf_block_rows; SELECT i.relname AS index_name, am.amname, pg_size_pretty(pg_relation_size(i.oid)) AS index_size, i.reloptions FROM pg_index x JOIN pg_class i ON i.oid = x.indexrelid JOIN pg_class t ON t.oid = x.indrelid JOIN pg_am am ON am.oid = i.relam WHERE t.relname = 'task81_nprobe_100k_corpus' ORDER BY i.relname;

steps.name: precheck-task81-local-nprobe-surface
args: CREATE EXTENSION IF NOT EXISTS ecaz; SELECT now() AS captured_at, version() AS postgres_version; SELECT count(*) AS corpus_rows FROM task81_nprobe_100k_corpus; SELECT count(*) AS query_rows FROM task81_nprobe_100k_queries; SELECT c.relname, c.relpages, c.reltuples::bigint AS reltuples, c.reloptions FROM pg_class c WHERE c.relname = 'task81_nprobe_100k_idx'; SELECT name, setting, context FROM pg_settings WHERE name IN ('ec_spire.leaf_block_rows', 'ec_spire.leaf_block_pruning_max_blocks_per_leaf', 'ec_spire.leaf_block_pruning_max_global_blocks', 'ec_spire.leaf_block_pruning_global_probe_blocks', 'ec_spire.leaf_block_pruning_sample_rows_per_block', 'ec_spire.leaf_block_pruning_sample_summary_prior_weight', 'ec_spire.leaf_block_pruning_summary_radius_weight', 'ec_spire.leaf_block_pruning_route_prior_weight', 'ec_spire.nprobe', 'ec_spire.rerank_width') ORDER BY name;
